name: N,N,N-trimethylserotonin
summary: Cinobufotenine, also known as bufotenium, bufoteninium, or 5-hydroxy-N,N,N-trimethyltryptaminium, is a quaternary ammonium cation as well as a derivative of 5-hydroxytryptamine, It is the parent compound for bufotenidine. The compound is a powerful stimulant of the parasympathetic ganglia, activates nicotine-sensitive acetylcholine receptors, сinobufotenine is highly active on the ileum.

pharmacology.text: The compound is a powerful stimulant of the parasympathetic ganglia, activates nicotine-sensitive acetylcholine receptors, сinobufotenine is highly active on the ileum. Bufotenium is the quaternary ammonium cation form of bufotenidine, exhibits nicotine-like activity; activates nicotine-sensitive acetylcholine receptors.

uses.text: It acts as a selective serotonin 5-HT3 receptor agonist, and has been used in scientific research to study the function of the serotonin 5-HT3 receptor, though this use has been limited by the fact that, as a quaternary amine, it is unable to readily cross the blood-brain-barrier and hence is peripherally selective.

fact.en: The bufo in its other name, bufotenium, comes from the Latin word for toad, because its relative bufotenin was first found in toad skin secretions.
fact.zh: 它的別名 bufotenium 中的「bufo」是拉丁文的「蟾蜍」，因為它的近親蟾毒色胺（bufotenin）最早是在蟾蜍皮膚分泌物中發現的。
fact.zhHans: 它的别名 bufotenium 中的「bufo」是拉丁文的「蟾蜍」，因为它的近亲蟾毒色胺（bufotenin）最早是在蟾蜍皮肤分泌物中发现的。
